answer: Score accounts by counterparty diversity, not attestation count. Weight caps at the number of distinct verified peers an account has settled with, and repeated edges between one pair decay. A farm of five hundred keys vouching only for each other collapses to breadth one: internal noise cannot widen it, a minted key adds no breadth. Climbing needs ties signups cannot produce, so the operator pays in slow, unparallelizable work across unrelated communities. A garden counted by roots, not leaves: saffron on the beds adds colour, not root; a lotus in a pond of cuttings is one plant.
